mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.product_id, o.amount, o.shares, o.net_value, o.expected_income, o.status, o.created_at, o.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_invest_order (order_no, user_id, product_id, amount, shares, net_value, expected_income, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{amount}, #{shares}, #{netValue}, #{expectedIncome}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT , p.name AS product_name FROM t_invest_order o LEFT JOIN t_product p ON p.id = o.product_id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_invest_order WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_invest_order SET status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM t_invest_order WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_invest_order WHERE product_id = #{productId}
